description_en: Creates a custom image from a deployed cloud computer to quickly create more cloud computers with the same configuration, avoiding repeated configuration each time
description_zh: 通过已部署好的云电脑创建自定义镜像，以便快速创建更多相同配置的云电脑，避免每次创建时重复配置
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --image-name testImageName --description This_is_description. --snapshot-id s-2zefuwk8l6ytcgd3bf4o --image-resource-type deprecated --snapshot-ids s-2ze2ai7op1duq4mnx5ha --auto-clean-userdata false --disk-type ALL --data-snapshot-ids s-4kn5xu2j4d0z1r4x8 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImage

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: image_resource_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to clear personal user data. If this parameter is set to `true`, the created image clears data in all directories under `C:\Users` except the `Administrator` and `Public` directories
parameters.help_zh: 是否清除用户个人数据。若设为`true`，制作的镜像会清除`C:\Users`目录下除`Administrator`、`Public`之外的其他目录的数据
parameters.name: auto_clean_userdata

parameters.help_en: The disk data included in the image
parameters.help_zh: 镜像中包含的磁盘数据
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The list of data cloud disk snapshot IDs. To include data cloud disks when creating an image, specify the corresponding data cloud disk snapshot IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘快照ID列表。创建镜像时，如果需要包含数据盘，请指定对应的数据盘快照ID。最多支持100个
parameters.name: data_snapshot_ids
